payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over start i, extend j while product <= (sum+remaining ones)*k; handle runs of 1s in O(1). Break when product exceeds bound, pruning impossible extensions.
payload.rationale: Solution uses complete search with pruning: break condition based on product > (sum+remaining ones)*k, which is a branch-and-bound bounding technique. No backtracking (no state reversal).
